row.proto: void Vm_Set_BoolNodeSlot_OptClearAll12(void *slots, int32_t *index, uint8_t value, int32_t *mode)
row.notes: slots holds 12 node handles at +8 with stride 0x20. If *mode==1 it first writes false to every valid bool node (0x188/0x20 = 12 slots), then if *index<12 writes value to slot[*index] via Vm_NodeSet_Bool after checking the node is valid and of g_Vm_BoolTypeDesc type. Works as a radio-button style setter. Context from caller: lobby ready-state and objective banner view-models.
